spanish: Y nombre de la mujer la herida, la midyanita: Kozbi hija de Tsur, cabeza de tribus de casa de padre en Midyán él.

findings.issue: אֻמּוֹת is plural absolute, so it ends the construct headed by רֹאשׁ. “tribus de casa” makes that absolute govern בֵּית, which the morphology does not mark.

notes: The other tokens match, including the final 3ms pronoun with no added copula.
